items.title: Registration & Morning Welcome
items.description: Check-in and light refreshments. Welcome remarks from SEASI leadership.

items.title: Student Paper Presentations — Panel I

items.description: Networking lunch for attendees, presenters, and faculty.

items.description: Closing reception with dinner. An opportunity to connect with scholars, students, and advocates.
